The build uses standard Meson commands, which are safe and expected in AUR packages. Installation places built binaries and license files into standard system directories under $pkgdir, which is proper for Arch packaging.

Checksums are provided for the source tarball, with the signature set to SKIP, which is common and acceptable for VCS-based packages when signature verification is used instead. The PGP key used (34FF9526CFEF0E97A340E2E40FDE7BE0E88F5E48) belongs to the upstream developer (emersion) and is appropriate. No network requests, file operations, or execution of downloaded code occur outside the expected build flow.

The package depends only on Wayland and build-time dependencies, which are reasonable for a Wayland-native application. No suspicious commands such as curl|bash, eval, or base64 decoding are present. All operations align with standard AUR packaging practices and the stated purpose of the software.
